candidates.place_reason: 306e audit 2026-10-13: similarity (6 pts, resid 0.0 m, 1.00 m/px, 0.0 deg). The 6 anchors are a perfect 900-px grid, so the fit carries no placement information (the bury-castle ladder class). The drawn outer-wall square spans 954 x 927 m against the real fort's ~250 x 210 m (~3.8x too big) with its centre ~440 m NW of the real fort; the drawn NW keep lands ~865 m NW of the real keep, over village farmland west of the site; only the drawn Church of St Mary sits near its real church (~100 m N). The plate's own 0-500 ft bar implies ~5x the true scale - a 1836 drawing, not a survey. Wrong place, wrong size, right kind. Document deleted.
